title: Sensibo AC Runtime Weekly Target Temperature Trend
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sensibo:climate target_temp_c=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(target_temp_c) as avg_duration, max(target_temp_c) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst target temperature for Sensibo AC runtime events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture target_temp_c on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average target temperature with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It automatically whether Sensibo AC runtime tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
